data.name: Osbert
data.gender_notes: Osbert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Osbert derives from the Old English name Ósbeorht, which is composed of two elements: Ós, meaning wealth or riches, and beorht, meaning bright or spear. This name was popular among Anglo-Saxons, and it was borne by several saints and scholars throughout history. The name Osbert carries the meaning “Wealth, riches, spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Osbert usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, riches, spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
